comparison.objective: Route and seat a strut across keep-outs without disturbing a sensitive housing.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstacle-aware transport, handoff through a cradle, and tight saddle alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Both strut ends seated within millimetric tolerances while housing remains within motion/tilt limits, held 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests collision-free handoff and precision seating of one long object, not selective screening.
